title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Lease-End Terms: Credit for Early Written Termination Notice
content:
# Lease-End Terms — Credit for Early Written Notice on a Closed-End Unit, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Term.** For the early termination charge on a closed-end commercial unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease ended before its scheduled end date by a turn-in or by a recovery after an uncured default, the termination notice credit is $150 where the written termination notice was received 50 or more days before the turn-in date, $75 where it was received 40 to 49 days before the turn-in date, and nothing where it was received fewer than 40 days before or no termination notice is recorded on the unit.

**How the days are counted.** The days run from the termination notice date recorded on the unit to the turn-in date (the date the unit was turned in or recovered, as the unit records it); days between two dates count the later date but not the earlier one.

## Credit table

| Days from the notice date to the turn-in date | Termination notice credit |
|---|---|
| 50 or more | $150 |
| 40 to 49 | $75 |
| fewer than 40 | nothing |
| no termination notice recorded on the unit | nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical dates)

| Notice received | Turn-in | Days counted | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| day 0 | day 50 | 50 | $150 |
| day 0 | day 49 | 49 | $75 |
| day 0 | day 40 | 40 | $75 |
| day 0 | day 39 | 39 | nothing |

## Basis questions

- **What if the unit was recovered and no notice was ever given?** No termination notice is recorded on the unit, so the credit is nothing.
- **Which notice date counts?** The termination notice date the unit records.
